first_attempt_failures.probe: An initial isolated restore attempt exited nonzero before production activation. Its original evidence was retained privately; the successful retry has its own release-probe.json. No live database restore was attempted.
first_attempt_failures.source_transfer: Initial thin-bundle/partial-clone imports failed. A complete current commit snapshot was reconstructed and connectivity checked before build. Failures are retained privately.

scope: Release deployment, current source consistency and actual login/bootstrap/ticket WSS. Not natural-game completion, 50/100 capacity, full handbook 132-subtask acceptance or human experience.
subsequent_summary_only_commit_policy: A later report-only release commit may fast-forward cloud checkout without rebuilding this image only after checking that every deployed application/config/contract and client input is unchanged. Runtime image revision stays truthful at its actual build SHA.
